title: Yomi no Tsugai
synopsis: Sixteen years ago, twins Asa and Yuru were born in the secluded Higashi Village. While Yuru spends his days hunting animals and gathering provisions, Asa is forced to stay inside a cage, and only a se...
synopsis_es:
Hace dieciséis años, los gemelos Asa y Yuru nacieron en la apartada aldea de Higashi. Mientras Yuru pasa sus días cazando animales y recogiendo provisiones, Asa se ve obligada a permanecer dentro de una jaula, y sólo unos pocos elegidos pueden visitarla. Aunque sus padres los abandonaron hace mucho tiempo, Yuru jura quedarse y proteger a Asa mientras viva.

Un día, helicópteros y soldados armados se acercan repentinamente a la aldea primitiva y comienzan a ejecutar sin piedad a los aldeanos. Sin embargo, durante el caos, Yuru despierta a los dos protectores de la aldea, Izquierda y Derecha, que son sus Demonios, seres sobrenaturales creados para servir a su amo. Además, Yuru es testigo de cómo Asa es atacada por alguien que se parece a ella. Resulta que el atacante es en realidad el verdadero Asa, que huyó del pueblo con sus padres.

Cuando el conflicto llega a su fin, Yuru escapa de la aldea junto con Left, Right y Ryuu "Dera" Tadera, un vasallo Daemon que está dispuesto a ayudar a Yuru a integrarse en el mundo moderno que no conoce. Al darse cuenta de que toda su vida hasta ahora ha sido una mentira, Yuru se propone encontrar al verdadero Asa una vez más con la ayuda de sus demonios y Dera para reunirse con sus padres.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Asa and Yuru
episodes_data.description: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

episodes_data.title: Left and Right
episodes_data.description: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

episodes_data.title: Dera and Hana
episodes_data.description: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

episodes_data.title: Jin and Yuru
episodes_data.description: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

episodes_data.title: Hare and Tortoise
episodes_data.description: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa`s blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

episodes_data.title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
episodes_data.description: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.
episodes_data.title_es: El clan Kagemori y los asaltantes desconocidos

episodes_data.title: Asa and Break
episodes_data.description: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

episodes_data.title: Suspicion and Conviction
episodes_data.description: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they`re invited to breakfast by the clan head.

episodes_data.title: Embrace and Whisper
episodes_data.description: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.

episodes_data.title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
episodes_data.description: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they’re being followed.

episodes_data.title: Big Brother and Little Brother
episodes_data.description: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

episodes_data.title: Retainer and Shaman
episodes_data.description: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

episodes_data.title: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
episodes_data.title_es: Los hermanos Kagemori y los hermanos Kuroya
